We're all fine here now, thank you. How are you?|Han Solo and the Imperial|audio=Han-Toos-Part1-ANH.flac|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
An '''individual''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. When the crew of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|starship]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] eliminated the staff of [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], the Imperial contacted the block and anxiously inquired about the situation via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. The ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] hurriedly attended the comlink [[Speaker/Legends|speaker]] in the room and answered the Imperial, stating that the situation was under control. In a formal tone, the Imperial asked what had happened, before stating a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was going to be dispatched to the block. Solo then replied that there was an energy leak. The Imperial then demanded his name and operating number before Solo destroyed the speaker.<ref name="ANH Novel" />
